[SWS_CM_00072] Reception of Non-Time-Synchronous Control Format mes-
sages
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00004
⌈
If an
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message is received and the attribute
IEEE1722TpAcfConnection.acfMaxTransitTime
is not defined, then the
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message shall be processed immediately.
⌋
